title: 30亿英镑豪掷：股价仅涨0.5%，市场为何不买账
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: Charlie, you've unveiled what appears to be a fairly good set of numbers.
segments.zh: 查理，你公布的数据看起来相当不错。

segments.en: Good set of numbers. You've got a five-year plan that looks ambitious. The stock is only up, the stock is up by half of 1% now.
segments.zh: 数据不错。五年计划看起来雄心勃勃。股价只涨了0.5%。

segments.en: See, that's an underreaction. Would you have expected more? This is an exciting picture you're painting here, isn't it?
segments.zh: 这反应不足。你期望更多吗？你描绘的前景令人兴奋，不是吗？

segments.en: Yeah, look, as I said, it announced two things today.
segments.zh: 是的，正如我所说，今天宣布了两件事。

segments.en: First of all, the strong set of Q2 results. But that's really the end of our five-year strategy.
segments.zh: 首先是强劲的第二季度业绩，但这实际上是五年战略的终点。

segments.en: And that strategy, we've got the group back to growth. We've been winning market share.
segments.zh: 该战略让我们重回增长，我们一直在赢得市场份额。

segments.en: We've actually had really strong support from our shoulders and they've seen the story and realised the transformation that we've been leading.
segments.zh: 我们得到了股东的大力支持，他们看到了我们的故事，并认识到我们正在引领的转型。

segments.en: And then the second thing is laying out our new strategy for 2030.
segments.zh: 第二件事是公布我们2030年的新战略。

segments.en: We're calling it Accelerate 2030. And that's about raising our ambition on how we make every one of our customers get a simpler, smarter, more connected experience
segments.zh: 我们称之为“加速2030”。这旨在提升我们的目标，让每位客户在零售、商业、保险和财富业务中获得更简单、更智能、更互联的体验。

segments.en: right across our retail, commercial, insurance and wealth businesses.
segments.zh: 覆盖我们的零售、商业、保险和财富业务。

segments.en: And we're going to be investing £3 billion a year over that four-year period.
segments.zh: 未来四年，我们每年将投入30亿英镑。

segments.en: And we've got some exciting growth to do what you said. Continue to grow at mid-single digits, continue to diversify the revenue streams and live a very strong shoulder returns.
segments.zh: 我们有一些令人兴奋的增长计划，正如你所说，继续实现中个位数增长，持续多元化收入来源，并保持强劲的股东回报。

segments.en: And there's some exciting things coming. I'll give you some teasers. But a new smart wallet, Lloyd Smartwallet being launched today.
segments.zh: 未来还有更多精彩。我先透露一些：今天推出新的智能钱包Lloyd Smartwallet。

segments.en: The first integrated transport ecosystem being launched.
segments.zh: 首个一体化交通生态系统也将上线。

segments.en: We think we can get a million new people saving with our AI tools.
segments.zh: 我们相信，借助AI工具，能让一百万人开始储蓄。

segments.en: And we're going to be the most rewarding bank in the UK. So lots to come.
segments.zh: 我们将成为英国最具回报感的银行，敬请期待。
